title: New chat creates a new conversation: null conversation_id is never sticky
description: A WebSocket session-contract fix in the agent services: conversation_id null unconditionally creates a conversation and emits conversation_created; persist_user_turn drops a dead parameter. Backend services and their tests changed; the wire consumer is the chat frontend over the WS exception, so no proxy handler is involved.
notes: Seeded from the change record's affected_components (agents, backend-api) plus chat-frontend, which the record's compatibility_impact names as the consumer whose expectation the fix restores - the conversation_created event travels the WS exception, not the proxy. Validators are the ones the record actually ran. The untyped-WS-events policy governs the event emission this change altered.
